title: Store contract: record types, the one store interface, in-memory store, gh runner, store IPC and the Grillo folder layout rules
story: This issue added Grillo's one store interface over the PRD records, a full in-memory version and the typed gh runner, with one IPC channel per store method plus settings channels. No screen changed. The only thing a user can drive is the GRILLO_STORE setting: memory gives made-up data, and leaving it unset gives GitHub, whose every call answers 'not implemented yet' until issues #73 and #74 land.

checks.criterion: The store feature registers when the app starts, and GRILLO_STORE picks the backend
checks.steps: In a fresh checkout of main, run npm ci. Set GRILLO_STORE=memory and GRILLO_DEV_PORT=5173, then run npm run dev.
checks.expected: The terminal shows 'starting electron app...', the Grillo window opens, and no error lines appear.

checks.criterion: An unknown GRILLO_STORE value is refused by name
checks.steps: Set GRILLO_STORE=bogus, then run npm run dev.
checks.expected: The terminal shows "GRILLO_STORE must be 'memory' or 'github', got 'bogus'", and no Grillo window opens.
